name: NJM2114 / JRC2114
type: Bipolar low-noise audio dual, NPN input, 5532-type
tagline: JRC's faster, lower-offset NJM5532 replacement; stock socketed part on Creative X-Fi/ZxR/AE-9 and ASUS Essence STX.

lineage.note: Sole source; introduction date unknown. In volume use by 2009 (Essence STX). Datasheet Ver.2012-07-26.
Formed 1 Jan 2022 from New JRC and Ricoh Electronic Devices. Reportedly lists NJM2114 as a maintenance (保守品) product.

part_numbers.note: DIP-8. Maintenance product (2023 report); Marutsu 557442 sales ended. Mouser 513-NJM2114D, DigiKey 11685570.
Noise-selected D-rank DIP-8 (limit not captured). Sold by Akizuki (g117705) and Keisei.
DMP-8 SMD, Mouser 513-NJM2114M. Also M-TE1/-TE3, MD, MD-TE3. Near-term discontinuation (distributor).
SIP-8, different pinout. Obsolete per Mouser lifecycle.
Marking/trade name (JRC logo + '2114D'), not orderable. Aliases JRC2114DD, 2114DD.
DMP-8 reel at DigiKey (1286476); Profusion lists it obsolete.

key_specs.value: Bipolar NPN; internally compensated, standard dual pinout
key_specs.condition: D and M packages; SIP-8 differs

reputation.summary: A mid-tier Japanese audio dual sold and perceived as an improved NJM5532. JP reviews of the DD grade are mostly positive (firm bass, more clarity than NJM2068); one ranks it below NE5532. Best known abroad as the stock JRC2114 in Creative and ASUS sound cards; Soomal calls it a neutral buffer/I-V part. No independent measurements.
typical_uses: Creative X-Fi Titanium HD, Zx, ZxR, X7, AE-9 (with LME49710/NE5534)
ASUS Xonar Essence STX I/V converter
E-MU 0202, Gigabyte Z170X-Gaming G1, TempoTec DAII Plus
Drop-in NJM5532/NJM2068/NJM4580 swap in JP DIY gear
Reportedly I/V in some Philips/Marantz CD players (unverified)
caveats: Soomal (AE-9, 2020): swapping JRC2114 brings little; upgrade the NE5534 singles instead (e.g. LME49710).
Mixed JP rankings: one comparison (likely nabe.adiary.jp) rates it C-rank, below NE5532, LM4562 and OPA2134.
Maintenance status (2023), Marutsu sales ended, NJM2114L obsolete: expect shrinking stock and more grey-market parts.
5532-class bipolar input: bias current and source impedance matter; 13 MHz GBW needs sensible decoupling.
Zigsow DD review: 'same price class as NE5532 but better sound'.

counterfeit_notes: No NJM2114-specific counterfeit reports; 'JRC2114D' is just the genuine marking. Grey-market risk rises as stock shrinks; marketplace lots use every alias. Buy from Mouser (513-NJM2114D / 513-NJM2114M), DigiKey, Akizuki or Keisei; check marking and date code match the DD grade.

silicon_changes.summary: A Japanese audio blog reports Nisshinbo designated several ex-JRC op-amps as maintenance products (保守品, planned for discontinuation): NJM2114 with NJM4556A, NJM2082DD, NJM4560, NJM2041, NJM2043. NJM2068/NJM4580 inclusion unconfirmed. Lifecycle change only, no silicon change.
silicon_changes.identification: Distributors flag NJM2114L and NJM2114M-TE2 obsolete and NJM2114M as near-term discontinuation. Nisshinbo's 2025 DIP8 NRND notice excerpt does not show NJM2114D.
silicon_changes.audio_impact: None; supply and lifecycle warning only.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: no silicon change, only future availability risk; affected packages unknown
silicon_changes.verification: Blog, Nisshinbo list page and distributor lifecycle flags agree; no Nisshinbo notice naming NJM2114 seen.

claims_confirmed: NJM2114 (bipolar NPN input) is among ex-JRC op-amps designated maintenance (保守品) products: https://foxtango101.blog.jp/archives/19678237.html
Marutsu's NJM2114D page shows sales ended: https://www.marutsu.co.jp/pc/i/557442/
Nisshinbo's maintenance list covers products to be discontinued soon, for current projects only: https://www.nisshinbo-microdevices.co.jp/ja/design-support/discon/njx_discon.html
Datasheet Ver.2012-07-26 lists DIP8/DMP8/SIP8 and an NJM5532-replacement claim: https://www.rxelectronics.ph/datasheet/57/njm2114l.pdf
±3.0 to ±22.0 V, 15 V/µs, 13 MHz, 0.9 µVrms, 60 mA: https://www.alldatasheet.com/datasheet-pdf/pdf/7258/NJRC/NJM2114.html and https://www.digchip.com/datasheets/parts/datasheet/330/NJM2114.php

Kyohritsu and IBS copies carry footer Ver.2012-07-26; no newer edition surfaced (https://kyohritsu.com/eclib/OTHER/DATASHEET/JRC/njm2114.pdf, https://datasheets.ibselectronics.com/NJM2114D-NJR-datasheet-37004363.pdf).
Distributor: NJM2114M to be discontinued in the near term, for current customers only (https://xonelec.com/mpn/nisshinbo/njm2114m).

NJM2114L listed obsolete (https://www.conevoelec.com/productdetail/nisshinbo-micro-devices-inc-njm2114l-11685294, https://fpgacenter.com/product/nisshinbo-micro-devices-inc/NJM2114L); NJM2114M-TE2 listed obsolete (https://us.profusion.uk/int/njm2114m-te2).

Nisshinbo MNG-2025-0081 (2025-06-16): DIP8 and TO-220F-3 products to NRND; last buy 2027-09-30, last ship 2028-03-31 (https://mm.digikey.com/Volume0/opasdata/d220001/medias/docus/7136/NRND_MNG-2025-0081.pdf).
refuted_claims: NJM2114D 'still listed by Marutsu (item 557442)' is outdated: the page shows sales ended.
